name: blender-design
description: Design, review, and export Blender scenes through controlled operations, visual milestones, and recovery checkpoints.

description_i18n.en: Design Blender scenes through controlled operations, visual milestones, recovery checkpoints, and verified file exports.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 通过受控操作、里程碑截图、事务回滚与校验导出，让智能体安全地设计 Blender 场景；含白模预演（previs）与即梦交接。

blender_session_descriptor.title: Blender 会话描述符
blender_session_descriptor.description: 多个 Blender 会话同时活跃时用于消歧；单会话留空即可（对应 CODEX_BLENDER_DESCRIPTOR）。

ffprobe_path.title: ffprobe 路径
ffprobe_path.description: 导出校验用的 ffprobe 可执行文件路径；留空则自动在 PATH 中查找（对应 CODEX_BLENDER_FFPROBE）。
